data.long_meaning: The name Himank is derived from the Sanskrit word 'himan', which means 'moon'. Another reference to 'Himank' can be found in the ancient Indian text, the Arthashastra, which is believed to have been written by Chanakya between 350 BCE and 275 BCE. In the text, Himank is mentioned as a military officer who served under the king of Magadha, Chandragupta Maurya.
